payload.text: What is VAF, and what minimum do we use for somatic calling?

result.definition: The fraction of sequencing reads at a position that carry the variant allele. A heterozygous germline variant sits near 0.5; somatic variants are diluted by normal cells, copy number and subclonality.

matches.snippet:
At 30x tumor coverage the limit of detection rose to 0.08 VAF.
Below 0.20 tumor purity, sensitivity for subclonal variants fell by roughly one third.
## Conclusions
The default min_vaf of 0.05 is supported only with at least 40x tumor coverage.
A 45x tumor minimum was modelled and is being evaluated under CHG-0024.
matches.title: Somatic SNV Calling Validation Summary

## Scope
This summary covers the limit of detection of somatic-snv calling on PCR-free WGS tumor and normal pairs.
## Results
At 40x tumor coverage the limit of detection was 0.05 VAF with 95 percent sensitivity.

Readqc fails when a selected library's coverage is below the confirmed minimum coverage.
Normal and germline libraries require a mean coverage of at least 30x.
Tumor libraries intended for somatic calling require a mean coverage of at least 40x.
The 40x tumor minimum replaced the earlier 30x minimum on 2025-11-03 under change CHG-0021.
Confirm min_coverage 40 when preparing a readqc draft for tumor libraries.

result.text:
L6: ## 2. Parameters
L7: The default minimum variant allele frequency is 0.05 for reportable somatic calls.
L8: Calls also need a minimum depth of 20 reads at the variant position in the tumor library.
L9: Analysts may lower min_vaf to 0.03 only when tumor coverage is at least 100x and the request documents why.
L10: There is no matched_normal parameter; the specimen query must contain both tumor and normal specimens.
L11: Missing normal specimens leave the draft invalid until a normal is added to the selection.

payload.text:
VAF (variant allele frequency) is the fraction of sequencing reads at a position that carry the variant. The default minimum for reportable somatic calls is **0.05 (5%)**, with at least 20 reads at the variant position in the tumor library. [sop-var-001-v2@2:L6-L8]

The validation supports a 0.05 detection limit at 40× tumor coverage; at 30×, the limit rises to 0.08. [val-som-2025-v1@1:L6-L8]
